name: Rosa Khutor
verdict: Part of Interros, the investment holding founded by Vladimir Potanin in 1990. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Sochi mountain resort; partner of HC Sochi (2026/27 club partners page). The resort's own press release (2025-09-17) says it is part of the Interros ecosystem; Kommersant and Interfax named Interros the owner in September 2025. No sourced human-rights finding against Interros or Potanin found. VEB.RF financed construction (loan) — a creditor relationship, not ownership.
